segments.caption: In a happy little house in Sydney lived the Rehman family.
segments.vo: In a happy little house in Sydney lived the Rehman family.

segments.caption: Mum, Dad, big brother Hamd, Aizah, and little Jazaa.
segments.vo: Mum, Dad, big brother Hamd, Aizah, and little Jazaa.

segments.caption: Dad, my friend says the family with the most money wins. Are we rich?
segments.vo: Dad, my friend says the family with the most money wins. Are we rich?

segments.caption: Ah, Hamd. We have a treasure bigger than any money. Shall we find it together?
segments.vo: Ah, Hamd. We have a treasure bigger than any money. Shall we find it together?

segments.caption: A treasure hunt! Yes!
segments.vo: A treasure hunt! Yes!

segments.caption: Clue number one was in the kitchen.
segments.vo: Clue number one was in the kitchen.

segments.caption: Dad works long days, and I work hard too, so you can have food, school and a warm home.
segments.vo: Dad works long days, and I work hard too, so you can have food, school and a warm home.

segments.caption: That's why we spend wisely, and buy only what we really need.
segments.vo: That's why we spend wisely, and buy only what we really need.

segments.caption: And we never waste food, right Mum?
segments.vo: And we never waste food, right Mum?

segments.caption: Never. Take a little, finish it all, and say Alhamdulillah.
segments.vo: Never. Take a little, finish it all, and say Alhamdulillah.

segments.caption: Clue number two was at the front door, with a basket of fruit and warm bread.
segments.vo: Clue number two was at the front door, with a basket of fruit and warm bread.

segments.caption: Uncle Yusuf next door is unwell today. Let's share with him.
segments.vo: Uncle Yusuf next door is unwell today. Let's share with him.

segments.caption: And I'll share my lunch with my friend Mia. She forgot hers!
segments.vo: And I'll share my lunch with my friend Mia. She forgot hers!

segments.caption: Clue number three came on the way home from the park.
segments.vo: Clue number three came on the way home from the park.

segments.caption: Some boys wanted me to skip school and be mean to a new kid. I said no, and walked away.
segments.vo: Some boys wanted me to skip school and be mean to a new kid. I said no, and walked away.

segments.caption: I'm proud of you. Good friends make you better. Choose them carefully.
segments.vo: I'm proud of you. Good friends make you better. Choose them carefully.

segments.caption: The last clue led to Grandpa's bench.
segments.vo: The last clue led to Grandpa's bench.

segments.caption: Salaam, Grandpa! Let me carry your tea for you.
segments.vo: Salaam, Grandpa! Let me carry your tea for you.

segments.caption: Grandpa smiled the biggest smile of all.
segments.vo: Grandpa smiled the biggest smile of all.

segments.caption: Dad, we found every clue. But where's the treasure?
segments.vo: Dad, we found every clue. But where's the treasure?

segments.caption: Look around you. Mum, Grandpa, all of us together. Our family is the treasure.
segments.vo: Look around you. Mum, Grandpa, all of us together. Our family is the treasure.

segments.caption: Spend wisely. Waste nothing. Help others. Choose good friends. Respect your elders.
segments.vo: Spend wisely. Waste nothing. Help others. Choose good friends. Respect your elders.

segments.caption: And love your family most of all!
segments.vo: And love your family most of all!
